title_zh: 穹顶开口右侧的望远镜
primary_anchor_zh: 望远镜位于穹顶开口右侧
story_reason_zh: 望远镜被移去校准，随后放回穹顶开口右侧

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 大型望远镜在暮色天文台穹顶内，保持静置。
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 望远镜位于穹顶开口右侧占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 望远镜沿地面轨道缓慢向左滑动并离开画面；随后呈现穹顶开口及其右侧空位。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 望远镜沿地面轨道缓慢向左滑动并离开画面
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。
shot_design.remaining_visual_zh: 穹顶开口及其右侧空位

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 望远镜沿轨道缓慢滑回画面并停在穹顶开口右侧
shot_design.main_action_zh: 望远镜沿轨道缓慢滑回画面并停在穹顶开口右侧
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 恢复望远镜位于穹顶开口右侧，参照物保持清楚可见。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed wide shot frames a large observatory telescope to the right of the broad dome opening. The telescope remains still.

A fixed wide shot shows a large observatory telescope to the right of the broad dome opening. The telescope slowly glides left along its floor rail until it leaves the frame. The fixed camera then holds on the broad dome opening and the empty floor to its right. The sky beyond the opening deepens gradually.

A fixed wide shot holds on the broad dome opening and the empty floor to its right. The large observatory telescope slowly glides back into frame along the floor rail and stops to the right of the broad dome opening.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 望远镜沿地面轨道缓慢向左滑动并离开画面
transition_design.shot_2_remaining_visual_zh: 穹顶开口及其右侧空位
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 望远镜沿轨道缓慢滑回画面并停在穹顶开口右侧
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
